title: A dispatch can claim a tick the operator already closed outside the run
body: ha9 was dispatched to this worker at fc9ad884 with the tracker snapshot showing it open, while fa9479e7 on origin/main (05:32:38Z, seconds after that base) closed ha9 and qu3 outside the run. The worker burned a full attempt discovering there was nothing to implement. A claim that re-reads the tracker (or folds the default branch) at claim/dispatch time would refuse the claim as already-closed instead of dispatching doomed work.
